messages:
Sam (Support): FYI — I've got 3 incoming asks that look like duplicates: Acme (support#4521), BetaCorp (sales#998), and an internal support convo. All ask for a way to tag/route customer requests in the product backlog so teams can filter by tenant.
Sam (Support): Short summary: storefront teams want per-tenant filtering on customer feature requests and intake items. They mentioned 'routing tags' + an API param to attach tenant_id.
Maria (Product): Got it. Can you paste the support links and a one-line ask for each customer? We should decide whether to merge into a canonical request or keep as separate feature variants.
Sam (Support): Acme: https://support/acme/4521 — "add tenant filter + API flag"
Sam (Support): BetaCorp: https://crm/beta/998 — "support team needs tenant-scoped view in backlog"
Sam (Support): internal thread: quick workaround request to tag items in the support UI.
Josh (Sales): Pinging — Acme & Beta are both in renewal conversations. Sales asks this be prioritized if we can ship a safe, incremental fix. Risk: churn if we don't provide path.
Maria (Product): Thanks @Josh. Proposal: merge into a single canonical ticket: "tenant-scoped intake & backlog filtering" with 2 phases: (1) API + backend filtering (tenant_id param, query filters, telemetry) and (2) UI: per-tenant backlog view + saved filters. Phase 1 would unblock integrations for sales/support. Thoughts?
Anya (Eng PM): Feasibility: phase 1 is straightforward — backend filter and API flag: ~2 sprints (backend + infra), plus minor validation. Phase 2 (UI) is another 1-2 sprints depending on design polish. We can do a minimal rollout: API + filter first, ship a basic UI later.
Maria (Product): OK. Prioritization suggestion: mark canonical ticket as P1 for accounts on renewal (Acme/Beta) and P2 for general backlog. Add tags: customer-ask, merge-canonical, needs-design, sales-impact.
Sam (Support): I'll draft status update to requesters. Suggestion for canned reply:
```
Hi <Customer>, thanks for raising this — we've consolidated similar requests and created a single feature ticket (RED-3456) to track tenant-scoped intake and backlog filtering. Phase 1 (API/filtering) is scheduled for near-term evaluation; we'll follow up with ETA once engineering confirms scope. For a faster workaround we can add a manual "tenant" tag in the support UI — would that help?
Regards, Sam
```
Maria (Product): I'll create the canonical ticket and link the three sources. Rollout criteria to include: API accepts tenant_id param, filtering returns no performance regression (95th % latency preserved), and telemetry shows tenant label present on incoming items. Also add customer acceptance check for Acme/Beta.
triage-bot: Created RED-3456: "tenant-scoped intake & backlog filtering" (assignee: Anya).
Anya (Eng PM): Assigned. I'll add a tech design doc and a short implementation plan. Can we get a product review next Tues?
Josh (Sales): I'll notify the AEs and ask Acme/Beta for acceptance testing once phase 1 is ready. Please mark any quick workaround as "customer-facing" so I can communicate it.
Sam (Support): I'll update each requester and CC @Josh. Will note interim workaround option. :thumbsup:
